draft.inside_message: Congratulations to you and Callum on three years. You two have built something good, and now there's a pottery business in the garage as well. Hope you both get an evening off to enjoy it.

artwork_brief.style_note: light scattered sparks, hand-drawn feel, warm colours

draft.rationale: Leans on the anniversary with Callum and the new pottery business, in a brother's warm informal voice, with fresh wording so it doesn't echo last week's birthday card.
